note: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands are a British overseas territory under the British Nationality Act 1981, its people British overseas territories citizens or British citizens; the United Kingdom issues no national identity card (Identity Documents Act 2010), so they hold none.

sources.title: legislation.gov.uk, British Nationality Act 1981, Schedule 6 (British overseas territories)
sources.said: [ F6 South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands ]

sources.title: GOV.UK, Types of British nationality: British overseas territories citizen
sources.said: Rights as a British overseas territories citizen You can: hold a British passport get consular assistance and protection from UK diplomatic posts ... Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands Turks and Caicos Islands You’ll also be a British citizen if you were born outside the UK or in a British overseas territory to a parent who is a British citizen in their own right.

sources.title: legislation.gov.uk, Identity Documents Act 2010, section 1, Repeal of Identity Cards Act 2006
sources.said: Repeal of Identity Cards Act 2006 ... The Identity Cards Act 2006 is repealed.

sources.title: legislation.gov.uk, Identity Documents Act 2010, section 2, Cancellation of ID cards etc
sources.said: No ID cards are to be issued by the Secretary of State at any time on or after the day on which this Act is passed. ... All ID cards that are valid immediately before that day are to be treated as cancelled by the Secretary of State at the end of the period of one month beginning with that day.
